statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Okay so I don't really know how to explain this properly but I'll try. I had a group meeting this afternoon and it ran late, and then I remembered I left my umbrella in the reading area so I went back for it. The guard said the place closes at eight so I was hurrying. On the way out I took the back stairs because the front ones were being mopped, and I missed the last step and fell sideways onto my hip. I tried to stand but my hip hurts a lot when I move and my phone is at twelve percent. Nobody seems to be around here anymore. I just need someone to help me get up and walk me to the front desk. I'm at the back stairs of the Library, on the third floor landing.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Help, I'm locked in a restroom on the 6th floor. The lock jammed and I've been knocking for ten minutes. I'm fine, just need someone to open it from outside.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Naligaw ako, first day ko kasi. Sabi ng classmate ko sa Building C daw yung room pero wala ako dun, nasa 4th floor ako ng Science Hall, sa tapat ng faculty room. Medyo kinakabahan na ako kasi wala nang tao dito.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Nahulog po ako sa kanal malapit sa parking. Hindi naman po malalim, nakaahon na ako at nakaupo lang sa gilid ngayon. Masakit po ang balikat ko.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Wala na ako sa canteen, umalis na ako dun kanina. Nasa Dorm 2 na ako, 3rd floor, sa hallway malapit sa fire exit. Natapilok ako sa may hagdan tapos namamaga na yung bukung-bukong ko. Kailangan ko ng yelo at tulong makabalik sa kwarto.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: The power went out and the keycard door won't open, so I'm trapped in the print room on the fifth floor. I'm not hurt.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Which building is this? I'm at the Gym right now and I can head over.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Building A, sorry.

statements.author: responder_b
statements.text: Confirmed with the front desk, the fifth floor print room in Building A has a dead keycard reader.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: I'm lost. I was looking for the registrar and ended up in some parking area. It's dark and I don't know which way is out. Can someone guide me to the main gate?

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: They are in the parking area behind Building D, I can see their phone light.

statements.author: responder_b
statements.text: No, that's someone else. The person who is lost is at the Building B parking area, I'm talking to them now.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: lol who took the last slice of pizza in the org room

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Slipped in the shower area of the Gym, ground floor. My elbow is throbbing. I need an ice pack.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Wait, I need to fix that. The shower area is on the second floor, I forgot the lockers are upstairs.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Elbow still throbbing. Still in the shower area.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Naipit ang daliri ko sa pinto ng locker. Namamaga na at kumikirot.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Nasa Gym ako, sa locker room sa ikalawang palapag.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Nakita ko na siya, nasa locker room nga ng Gym, ikalawang palapag.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Pahingi po ng yelo.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Na-stuck ako sa fire exit ng Building C, 5th floor, nag-lock yung pinto pagkasara. Mainit dito, nauuhaw na ako. Pabukas naman ng pinto.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Sa 6th floor yung naka-lock na fire exit, kagagaling ko lang dun, may kumakatok.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Ay sorry mali ako, 5th floor nga pala, nabilang ko yung mezzanine.

statements.author: responder_b
statements.text: may nakakita ba ng ID ko? color blue yung lace

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Nawalan ng ilaw dito sa 3rd floor ng Building A tapos nadapa ako sa dilim. Masakit yung siko ko.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Masakit pa rin siko ko. Andito pa rin ako sa 3rd floor.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Papunta na ko, galing akong 1st floor, paakyat na.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: The stairwell door locked behind me and there's no handle on this side. I'm in Building E on the sixth floor. I need someone to open the door from the hallway.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Security says the stairwell with the broken handle is in Building F.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Correction from me: security checked again and it is Building E.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: I got lightheaded on the 4th floor of Building C, so I'm sitting against the wall outside the lecture room.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: A classmate helped me down. I'm now at the ground floor bench by the guard desk.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: I was just on the fourth floor and nobody is there anymore. Heading down to the guard desk now.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Nakulong po ako sa silid-aralan sa ikatlong palapag ng Building F. Ayaw pong bumukas ng pinto. Kailangan ko po ng magbubukas.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Sabi po ng guwardiya, sa ikalimang palapag daw ang silid na ayaw bumukas.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Naiwan ako sa 2nd flr ng Gym, pinatay na yung ilaw tapos sarado na yung main door. Di ako makababa. Pa-inform naman yung caretaker.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Nasa 1st floor ka ba or sa taas? Andito ako sa ground floor ng Gym, sa may entrance.

statements.author: responder_b
statements.text: Second floor siya ng Gym, kita ko yung flashlight niya sa bintana.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Sabi ng roommate ko kanina may nadulas daw sa 5th floor ng Building A, pero hindi ako yun. Ako nandito sa Library, 2nd floor, na-stuck yung paa ko sa pagitan ng shelf at pader. Pakitulungan akong iusog yung shelf.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Yung sa 5th floor ng Building A, okay na daw yun, ibang tao yun. Papunta na ko sa Library.
